ns2:section.sectionText: This course meets in 4001 BIF. Given the increasing emphasis and expectations for PhD students to publish (or at least submit) manuscripts prior to graduation, we are offering a new workshop course to prepare and assist students in this endeavor. This course is designed to both demystify the paper development process and provide students with a hands-on, structured roadmap. The final deliverable for the seminar is the submission of the course-related manuscript to a conference (with the eventual goal of journal submission).
